technical-summary: Remove the control-socket tamper defences (run directory ownership and mode refusal, socket lstat/mode/owner verification, SO_PEERCRED peer check, owned-only stale socket removal, O_NOFOLLOW lock) and their public helpers; an existing run directory of any mode starts and a stale socket is replaced. Tests assert that behaviour.
user-summary-candidate: The session control socket no longer refuses run directories or sockets by permission or owner.
